scope: Optional presentation assets for photographs already rendered by the unchanged production homepage snapshot. No new editorial photographs or invented page content.
metricsMethod: PSNR compares decoded AVIF to the existing WebP at equal target pixel dimensions. At responsive gaps the old image is resized only for this diagnostic metric, including an at-most one-pixel height rounding adjustment. This is not a fixed 38 dB approval or a claim that every candidate has equal pixel values. Separate CSS-scale A/B inspection checks perceived quality, framing and colour.

encoder.selection: Highest tested quality saving at least 15% against the existing WebP browser-delivery candidate. If any width cannot meet that, retain that complete photo family as original WebP.

provenanceMethod: Only existing approved homepage photographs are used. Each presentation asset derives from the largest published WebP for that same photo ID, not a generated image or a remote replacement. Existing licence, credit, ALT text, original files, WebP URLs, responsive WebP sets and manifest entries remain intact.

cssScaleVisualReview.comparisonSource: Actual image CSS bounding boxes and legacy resource URLs recorded in the original PSI report at mobile 412px / DPR1.75.
cssScaleVisualReview.verdict: Side-by-side visual inspection at the actual displayed CSS dimensions found preserved framing, colour, tree/building detail and apparent sharpness, with no visible blocking, halos or objectionable smoothing. Metrics remain recorded without asserting pixel identity.

comparisons.comparison: Both decoded resources resized to their actual PSI CSS box with the same centre-cover framing. This is a CSS-scale visual reference, not a new Lighthouse run.

auxiliarySourceLayoutFix.reason: A source element inside display:contents otherwise becomes a zero-size flex item and contributes an extra gap in Chromium. Hiding the non-rendered source preserves AVIF selection and restores legacy image/text/footer geometry.
